title: Daily classic-pivot × H1 wick — named-level decomposition

hypotheses.market_question: Does the confirmed Daily/H1 pivot-specific wick interaction differ materially by named classic daily pivot tier, especially S1/R1 versus S2/R2?
hypotheses.null: The pivot-specific wick interaction at S1/R1 is not materially greater than at S2/R2 under the frozen parent geometry.
hypotheses.alternative: The pivot-specific wick interaction is materially greater at first-order S1/R1 than at second-order S2/R2.
hypotheses.mechanism: If first-order pivots represent a distinct local exhaustion geometry, strong rejection wicks should gain more incremental terminal information near S1/R1 than near S2/R2 after matched outer-zone control.

method.primary_endpoint: S1/R1 minus S2/R2 difference in pivot-specific strong-vs-weak wick interaction
controls: matched 30-50% outer zone for each named pivot

inference.method: pair-year clustered bootstrap on primary reconstructed tier contrast

holdout.prior_exposure: Consumed by DFXC-20260808-003. Parent preregistration already specified named-level diagnostics as descriptive only.

provenance.notes: Primary S1/R1 versus S2/R2 diagnostic contrast frozen before named-level outcome inspection. Science unchanged by later registry schema repair.
